$comment: Palette presets for scripts/preset.mjs: each colour seeds one source palette (Base 050–950 + Primes) through scripts/generate.cjs, kept exact as its tagged source. Add a preset by adding an entry; ids become CSS names. A preset's defaults apply to every palette; a request file overrides them.

field-operator.name: Field + operator (8)
field-operator.description: Eight seeds after Teenage Engineering's published field and operator accent palettes: four muted field colours and four saturated operator primaries.
